# SRS Database Model

```json
{
  "_id": 0,
  "username": "someusername",
  "subject": "kanji",
  "topic": "大",
  "srs_level": 1,
  "review_time": 123456790,
}
```

* `_id`: An id generated by mongodb
* `username`: A username for a user (unique)
* `subject`: The subject for the item (kanji, etc)
* `topic`: The topic under a specific subject (the specific kanji, etc)
* `srs_level`: Number indicating what stage of srs the particular subject is on
  * `0`: Available to be learned
  * `1+`: The various srs stages
* `review_time`: Unix time in seconds when the review is due. If the srs_level is maxed out, this time will indicate the time the user finished reviews.
